Through the morning of July 2 (UK time), the campaign has spent about $325 of the $450 budget. That's roughly 229,000 impressions, 150 link clicks and about 17 "Petition signed" conversions, which works out near $19 per signature. The two posts with the most sign-ups are the "Free to sign... until 4 July" post and the "Help us change the pace" post. Nothing is clearly underperforming, so I'll leave the setup as it is and wait for the flight to end.

The campaign ran from June 24 to July 4 (UK time), and it has now expired. It spent $447.16 of the $450.00 budget and produced 22 "Petition signed" conversions.

**Totals (whole flight)**

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Spend | $447.16 (of $450.00) |
| Impressions | 342,537 |
| Link clicks | 212 |
| "Petition signed" conversions | 22 |
| Cost per sign-up | about $20.33 |

**Per post**

| Post | Impressions | Link clicks | Sign-ups | Spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "Free to sign… until 4 July" | 96,142 | 53 | 7 | $125.51 |
| "Help us change the pace" | 95,512 | 83 | 8 | $125.35 |
| "Help us call for 20 mph limits" | 78,849 | 50 | 5 | $102.26 |
| "Our summer school-streets petition closes on 4 July" | 72,034 | 26 | 2 | $94.04 |

Four of the 22 conversions were view-through (someone saw the post but did not click), so the rest came from clicks. The spread between posts is small, so I didn't pause or reallocate any of them during the flight.

**What I set up**

- One campaign, "Gatelark Streets - Summer school streets petition 2027 (UK)", on the account's USD card.
- One ad group with a $40.90 daily budget and a $450 total cap, scheduled from 00:00 BST on June 24 to the end of July 4.
- Targeting: United Kingdom, and age over 18 (the platform's `AGE_OVER_18` option). The ads are limited to these, as X requires for political campaigning in the UK.
- Optimised for your "Petition signed" pixel, with all four approved posts attached and accepted.
- I checked delivery on June 24, June 26, June 29 and July 2, and each check was in line with the budget.

**Things to check on your side**

- The ads can only target by country and age. Residency and the 18+ requirement are enforced only on the petition page, so please confirm that page checks both.
- X's "Petition signed" count is a proxy. Please compare it with the petition's own signature count before reporting final numbers.
- About $2.84 of the budget was not spent.
